content.what_it_is: A MATLAB-generated single-page EPS plot for the IG-wave spectral input. It defines PostScript graphics/font resources, draws frequency and wave-spectral-density axes, overlays a dense blue data trace, a red filtered/model-input trace, and a dashed auxiliary trace, and closes with an in-figure legend and one-page trailer.
entities: EPSF document metadata and PostScript prolog (lines 1-938)
Single plot page and Cartesian axes (lines 939-1297)
Frequency axis labeled f (Hz) with ticks from 0 to 0.4 (lines 1298-1418)
Wave spectral density axis labeled WSD (m^2/Hz) with ticks from 0 to 8 (lines 1419-1593)
Legend entries Data and Filtered for model input (lines 3001-3057)
unresolved: The dashed third trace has no visible legend label in the EPS content, so its plotted meaning is not defined by this artifact.
